title: Digital Communications Officer
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 3 skills: youtube, word, customer support. Likely PH eligibility signal

position_overview: Communications Officer - (Ref: 250118) Permanent Band 5 Salary 34,544 - 43,039 Glasgow or Edinburgh remote working will apply for the foreseeable future The purpose of Healthcare Improvement Scotland is to ensure the people of Scotland experience the best quality of health and care. This is a rewarding and exciting chance for an enthusiastic and creative team player to join our organisations communications function. In this role, you will be involved in supporting the redevelopment and maintenance of our web estate, including our corporate website. Youll do this by creating, formatting, structuring, editing and publishing effective, user focused web content using your detailed knowledge of content management systems including Wordpress, Umbraco, Alterian Immediacy CMC and SharePoint. Youll also train and support others across the organisation to update their web content so its user friendly. As well as supporting our website, youll provide specialist support in the production of a range of digital communication content including website copy, high quality video content, audio podcasts, email marketing and digital graphics content. Youll distribute the completed digital content across a range of digital channels e.g. YouTube, Vimeo, website etc. You will demonstrate attention to detail in your work and be able to organise and structure complex information into logical, coherent website content. Youll also be able to identify the nature or any website technical issues and work with external contractors to resolve issues and develop new functionality where appropriate. This post will suit someone who has experience in a busy and varied multi-disciplinary communications environment. You will be educated to degree level in an appropriate specialist discipline or have relevant specialist experience. We offer first class working conditions, a great team environment and the opportunity to contribute to improving the health and social care that is delivered to people across Scotland. Closing date for receipt of applications: 14 June 2026 It is anticipated that interviews will be held on 30 June 2026 Please mention the word **REFUND** and tag ROjox when applying to show you read the job post completely (#ROjox). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
